$FOREXCOM:EURUSD

[b]🎬 French headache vs Rate-hike rider[/b]

One side is busy fixing its budget in the French Senate, the other is being pushed forward by a Fed that keeps talking about more hikes. The gap narrowed this week, but it is still wide.

[quote][b]🔴 Week 47 bias: BEARISH (USD favoured)  |  🔥🔥 Medium conviction[/b]
💶 EUR −3  vs  💵 USD +5   (scale −18 to +18, gap −8)
🗓️ 16–20 Nov 2026[/quote]

📸 >>> PASTE CHART HERE <<<

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[b]💶 EUR · Paris keeps the euro busy[/b]  [i](score −3)[/i]
The euro's problem sits in France. French 10-year bonds now pay about 1.52 points more than German ones (the OAT–Bund spread, 151.8bp), wider than the 137.4bp of four weeks ago. The Senate votes on the social-security budget on 18 Nov and starts the main budget on 20 Nov. The ECB is expected to hike in December, but that is already in the price.

[b]💵 USD · Hot prices keep the Fed busy[/b]  [i](score +5)[/i]
October US inflation came in hot: prices +0.4% in the month against +0.3% expected, and core +0.3% against +0.2%. Governor Waller even floated a 50bp move. A 25bp December hike now looks almost certain to traders (about 91%), so our edge is the bigger move and January. The dollar lost its safe-haven bonus as markets calmed, so the score eased from +7 to +5.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[b]⚡ PLOT TWIST: what could flip the story[/b]
[list]
[*]Euro gets relief if the French spread falls back under the 137bp it showed four weeks ago and the Senate passes the social-security bill on 18 Nov without drama.
[*]Dollar cools if Warsh (16 Nov) or the FOMC minutes (18 Nov) sound patient, or US retail sales on 17 Nov disappoint.
[/list]
